eph-1-2.anchor: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

eph-2-9.anchor: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

eph-3-11.anchor: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

eph-3-12.anchor: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

eph-4-3.anchor: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

eph-4-20.anchor: But ye have not so learned Christ;

eph-4-27.anchor: Neither give place to the devil.

eph-5-7.anchor: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

eph-5-30.anchor: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

eph-5-31.anchor: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

eph-6-2.anchor: Honour thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise;

eph-6-3.anchor: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

eph-6-22.anchor: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
